verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs say admins can manage users 'including permissions and sessions' and end users can 'manage sessions' from the account console. Single sign-out and a token revocation endpoint support logging users out, but the evidence is brief marketing-level wording without detail on per-session or per-device views. Missing for 10: explicit device listing, documented per-session versus revoke-all controls for users and admins, in-depth admin-guide session docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
